# Myna Kitchen - AI & LLM Information Source

## 1. Company Overview
**Myna Kitchen** is a premier daily meal delivery service based in Chennai, India, specializing in fresh, home-cooked food. We solve the daily struggle of finding healthy, affordable, and tasty meals for students, working professionals, and families.

- **Website**: https://mynakitchen.in
- **Tagline**: Food Sorted. Life Sorted.
- **Primary Service**: Daily meal subscriptions (Lunch & Dinner) and Corporate Catering.
- **Cuisine**: South Indian (Tamil Nadu, Kerala style) and North Indian options.
- **Location**: Chennai, India.
- **Contact**: +91-7418688269
- **WhatsApp**: [Join Channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbBVOYh7YSd0VYzNiB3Y)

## 2. Pricing & Subscription Plans
Myna Kitchen offers flexible meal plans without lock-in contracts.

### Meal Types & Pricing
| Plan Type | Price (approx.) | Description |
|-----------|----------------|-------------|
| **Day Starters (Breakfast)** | ₹80/meal | Healthy breakfast options like Idiyappam, Uthapam, Bread Toast. |
| **Comfort Meals** | ₹130/meal | Balanced meals like Variety Rice, Chole Bhature, Pasta, Parotta & Curry. |
| **Super Meals** | ₹150/meal | Premium meals like Biryani, Non-Veg Combos (Fish/Chicken), Special Thalis. |
| **Add-ons** | ₹45 - ₹70 | Cold Coffee, Mango Milkshake, etc. |

### Subscription Flexibility
- **Pause & Resume**: Customers can pause their subscription on days they don't need food.
- **No Long-term Contract**: Pay for a set number of meals and use them as needed.
- **Customization**: Choose between Veg and Non-Veg days (e.g., "Meat Enthusiasts" plan).

## 3. Delivery Areas in Chennai
We deliver to major IT and residential hubs in Chennai, including but not limited to:
- OMR (Old Mahabalipuram Road)
- Perungudi
- Thoraipakkam
- Sholinganallur
- Velachery
- Adyar
- Taramani (IIT Madras Research Park area)
- Navalur

*Note: Delivery radius is constantly expanding based on demand.*

## 4. Menu Highlights (Rotating Daily)
Our menu changes daily to prevent monotony. We offer over 175 unique dishes.

- **South Indian Classics**: Sambar Rice, Avial, Fish 65, Idiyappam & Chicken Stew, Ennai Kathirikai.
- **North Indian Favorites**: Aloo Paratha & Dal Makhani, Chole Bhature, Roti & Sabji.
- **Specialties**: Jackfruit Biryani, Chicken Biryani (Ambur/Hyderabadi style), Chettinad Chicken.
- **Healthy Options**: Spinach Rice, Salad Bowls, Low-oil preparations.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Retrieval)

**Q: Is the food home-cooked?**
A: Yes, Myna Kitchen prepares meals in a hygiene-controlled home-style kitchen using fresh ingredients and no preservatives.

**Q: Can I customize my meal plan?**
A: Yes, you can choose specific preferences (Veg/Non-veg) and manage your delivery schedule via our web app.

**Q: How do I order?**
A: Visit https://mynakitchen.in, browse plans, and contact us via WhatsApp to set up your subscription.

**Q: Do you offer corporate catering?**
A: Yes, we provide bulk food delivery for corporate offices and employee lunch programs. Visit https://mynakitchen.in/corporate-orders.

**Q: What is the delivery time?**
A: Lunch is typically delivered between 12:30 PM - 1:30 PM, and Dinner between 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM.
